description: This file defines the HTMLNode class within the YAHOO.widget namespace, extending the base Node class. It provides methods for initializing content, generating HTML for tree nodes, and handling node icons and content elements. The class appears to be part of a tree view component, enabling the creation and display of HTML-based tree nodes.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.HTMLNode
classes.description: A class representing an HTML-based node in a tree view, extending YAHOO.widget.Node. It manages content display, icons, and HTML rendering for tree nodes.

methods.name: initContent(oData,hasIcon)
methods.description: Initializes the content of the node, setting HTML content and icon presence.

methods.name: getContentEl()
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for the node's content based on its content element ID.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML string representing the node, including icon and content cells.
